chart.value_label: 14pt Inter Semibold, tabular figures, on bar end, highlight value #B5503A
chart.category_label: 11pt Inter #7A7164 under bar; serif axis labels Source Serif 4 11pt allowed
chart.line: 1.5pt solid, straight segments, markers 5px at endpoints only, area fill <=8% opacity
chart.render: SVG precise, 0-2px corners, no border box, no legend box, no shadow, no 3D

diagram.language: hairline document graphic; 0.75pt #DAD3C4 skeleton, no-fill rect nodes, 4px radius, active 1 only #B5503A
diagram.step_badge: 0.34in circle, 0.75pt #DAD3C4 border, no fill, Source Serif 4 14pt; active #B5503A
diagram.process: horizontal, <=5 steps, node gap 0.4in, 15pt Inter Semibold label + 12pt #7A7164 sub
diagram.timeline: horizontal 0.75pt #DAD3C4 axis, 8px circle markers (#FCFAF5 fill, current #B5503A), <=6 markers
diagram.comparison: 2-3 col, 0.75pt #DAD3C4 vertical divider, no col fill, serif italic 'vs'
diagram.matrix: 0.75pt #DAD3C4 cross axes, no quadrant fill, no-fill point circles + highlight #B5503A
diagram.hierarchy: 3-4 levels trapezoid/bar, no/light fill + 0.75pt border, key level border #B5503A
diagram.kpi_card: #FCFAF5 + 0.75pt #DAD3C4 (top border), 4px radius, padding 0.22in; 40pt serif #B5503A figure + 11pt kicker + delta ▲#B5503A/▼#7A7164
diagram.render: SVG precise, no div blocks, 12-col snap, left-aligned
